admission.justification: Guarded by dashboard/src/test/cssEscape.test.ts, preventing broken React Aria attribute selectors in jsdom tests when keys start with a digit, hyphen-digit, standalone hyphen, NULL, or ASCII control character.

applicability: The globalThis.CSS.escape stand-in defined in dashboard/src/test/setup.ts for Vitest jsdom runs.
conditions: Installed only when globalThis.CSS or globalThis.CSS.escape is absent.
Escapes leading ASCII digits, hyphen followed by a digit, standalone hyphen, NULL to U+FFFD, ASCII control characters, and punctuation per CSSOM identifier serialization.
exclusions: Native browser CSS.escape implementations when already defined on globalThis.CSS.
jsdom 25 nwsapi hex-escaped #id shorthand selectors; tests verify attribute selectors matching React Aria.

evidence: clean-copy npx vitest run src/test/cssEscape.test.ts (5/5 pass)

statement: The jsdom CSS.escape stand-in in dashboard/src/test/setup.ts implements CSSOM identifier serialization including leading digits, hyphen followed by a digit, standalone hyphen, NULL, and ASCII control characters, covered by dashboard/src/test/cssEscape.test.ts.
title: Jsdom CSS.escape stand-in follows CSSOM identifier serialization
